title: Data Engineer
description: A job-focused roadmap for building reliable batch and streaming data pipelines, warehouses, orchestration, and analytics-ready datasets.

tree.name: SQL, Python, and Data Modeling
tree.description: Learn the languages and modeling habits used to transform raw data into trusted tables.

resources.title: Complete Roadmap to Learn Data Engineering (Anshul Gupta)

children.name: Advanced SQL
children.description: Master joins, windows, CTEs, indexes, query plans, transactions, and data quality checks.

children.name: Dimensional Modeling
children.description: Design facts, dimensions, slowly changing dimensions, and analytics-friendly warehouse models.

tree.name: Batch Processing
tree.description: Move and transform files, tables, and large datasets with reproducible jobs.

resources.title: Data Engineering with Python and AI/LLMs (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: Apache Spark
children.description: Use DataFrames, Spark SQL, partitioning, and cluster-aware transformations.

children.name: dbt Transformations
children.description: Build tested SQL models, sources, docs, snapshots, and repeatable data transformations.

children.name: Practice: Dirty Data Cleaning Lab
children.description: Clean messy CSV/API data, document assumptions, add quality checks, and publish trusted transformed tables.

tree.name: Streaming and Orchestration
tree.description: Coordinate pipelines and process events for near-real-time systems.

children.name: Event Streaming
children.description: Understand topics, partitions, consumers, producers, schemas, and delivery tradeoffs.

children.name: Workflow Orchestration
children.description: Author DAGs, schedule jobs, handle retries, parameterize tasks, and monitor failures.

tree.name: Cloud Warehouses and Data Quality
tree.description: Operate data platforms with storage, permissions, testing, lineage, cost controls, and reliable delivery.

children.name: Data Quality and Lineage
children.description: Add tests, freshness checks, contracts, observability, and lineage to reduce broken dashboards.

children.name: Cost, Governance, and Privacy
children.description: Control warehouse costs, protect PII, document ownership, and apply retention and access policies.

children.name: Project: Analytics Pipeline
children.description: Ingest public data, transform it, test it, schedule it, and publish a dashboard-ready warehouse model.
